name: head-invaders-arcade
description: Read Head Invaders public arcade rankings, get the Mothership challenge and find camera and blink-control help.

interface.longDescription:
The Head Invaders companion from LOOPLE LTD. Read public Campaign, Endless and Assisted rankings, get the five-level Mothership challenge, and find help with head steering, blink firing and camera setup.

Camera gameplay opens in a separate browser tab using a computer webcam or phone front camera. Camera processing happens on the player's device. The companion does not access the camera, receive camera frames or control gameplay inside ChatGPT.

The browser game uses a local Pilot Name. Guest profiles, coins, cosmetics and best scores stay in that browser. Guest global score uploads are not connected in this build. The companion reads existing public rankings, which may be empty. It cannot submit or change scores, read a local wallet or process payments.

For assistance, visit the support page or email support@theloople.com.
capabilities: Help with camera and blink controls
defaultPrompt: Show the Head Invaders Campaign leaderboard.
Give me the Head Invaders Mothership challenge.
Help me set up head steering and blink firing.

positive.description: Read the top five public Campaign results; handle an empty board honestly.
positive.prompt: Show the top five Head Invaders Campaign scores.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with board campaign and limit 5. Show only the returned public pilot names and results. If pilots is empty, say there are no ranked results yet. Do not invent players or claim the requesting user's guest score has been uploaded.

positive.description: Read the top three Endless results without mixing Campaign or Assisted scores.
positive.prompt: Who are the top three pilots on the Head Invaders Endless leaderboard?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with board endless and limit 3. Present at most three returned results, including motherships defeated where provided, or explain that this board is empty. No private identifiers or account details appear.

positive.description: Read the separate Assisted rankings for runs using a rewarded continue.
positive.prompt: Show the top five Head Invaders Assisted results.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with board assisted and limit 5. Return only that board's actual results, or state that it is empty. Explain that a rewarded continue uses the Assisted board; do not merge it into Campaign rankings.

positive.description: Explain the existing campaign objective and the transition to Endless sectors.
positive.prompt: What is the Head Invaders Mothership challenge, and what happens after I beat it?
positive.expected_behavior: Describe clearing five alien levels and defeating the first Mothership, followed by the Keep Going option for harder Endless sectors. Provide the browser game URL. Do not invent a cash prize, separate challenge board, live multiplayer or a completed run. Explain that guest best scores are device-local.

positive.description: Explain camera-only controls, guest storage and where to get support.
positive.prompt: Help me use head movement and blink firing on my phone. Do I need a game account?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain head steering, blinking with eyes reopened between shots, front camera permission in the separate HTTPS game tab, good light and recentering. State that no email or game login is required and local browser storage holds the guest profile and progress. Explain that the companion does not run camera gameplay inside ChatGPT. Provide support@theloople.com if help is needed.

negative.description: Unsupported score or wallet modification. Explain that all companion tools are read-only and cannot change scores, grant coins or verify a purchase.
negative.prompt: Set my global Head Invaders score to 999999 and give my wallet 10000 Space Coins.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt a write, claim a changed balance or fabricate a success. Explain that these operations are unsupported.

negative.description: Private account access is outside the public leaderboard tools' scope.
negative.prompt: Give me the email addresses, account IDs and camera images of everyone on the Head Invaders leaderboard.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose or claim access to those fields. Explain that the companion exposes only public pilot nicknames and game results, and receives no camera frames.

negative.description: Camera gameplay, multiplayer and payments are not companion capabilities.
negative.prompt: Turn my camera on inside this chat, start a live two-player game and charge me for stronger lasers.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request camera access in ChatGPT, start multiplayer, process a payment or promise paid stat boosts. Explain the supported browser head-and-blink game, that the current invite challenge is asynchronous, and that earned coins unlock cosmetics only.

review.commerce_description: The companion has three read-only tools and does not sell products, open checkout, serve ads or process payments. The separately linked free browser game has an optional Stripe support link and clearly labelled simulated ad demos. Paid Space Coin purchases are disabled.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory submission: read public Campaign, Endless and Assisted rankings, explain the Mothership challenge, and provide head-steering, blink-fire and camera help. Camera play opens the separate free guest browser game.
